title: No Travel Origin, EU 261 (UK), Controllable, Cancellation Code POSI (SOM), aircraft availability (upline), Cash, single pax, 1 leg, no changes
description:
A UK-originating, AC-operated flight (LHR ? YYZ) was cancelled with code POSI (SOM). The aircraft couldn't be positioned at LHR because of an AC upline issue, which is controllable. The customer declined rebooking and stayed in London. No Travel Origin + UK origin + Controllable = GBP 520. APPR also applies (Canada destination), but EU-UK is more generous. Checks four things: (1) UK No Travel Origin is identified, (2) the flat UK cancellation amount is applied, (3) POSI (SOM) is classed as controllable, and (4) the dual-regime check (EU-UK and APPR) picks EU-UK.

Prerequisites:
PNR TC087: one passenger, Henry Whitfield (Adult). One AC-operated leg: AC 849 LHR ? YYZ, May 28, 2026, scheduled departure 10:00, scheduled arrival 14:00 (local YYZ). Status: CANCELLED. Cancellation code: POSI (SOM), aircraft availability, upline, controllable. Upline cause: inbound AC 848 YYZ ? LHR couldn't position the aircraft at LHR because of an AC operational issue (not on the customer's PNR). Fallback: FALSE (cancellation code available). The customer declined rebooking and stayed at LHR. No Travel status: Origin. Regimes: EU 261 (UK) + APPR. Filed June 24, 2026 (more than 72 hours after scheduled departure, within the UK 6-year limit). No duplicate. Aeroplan: not linked, so Cash only. Residence: United Kingdom, so GBP and BSM email payment. CyberSource set to GREEN. Persona set to IDV PASS.
